unsupported: Founded in 1992 in White Hall, West Virginia, Pick-Up City operates as an auto and truck recycling business under President Grant Kelly.
Pick-Up City supplies repair shops, collision centers, fleet operators, and individual vehicle owners throughout the region and nationwide via common carrier.
The company emphasizes its indoor, climate-controlled storage, environmentally responsible fluid handling, and a searchable digital catalog as key differentiators.

Known for: Over 65,000 parts in a searchable computerized inventory; 78,000 sq ft indoor climate-controlled warehouse; Free regional delivery and nationwide shipping via common carrier; 30- to 90-day warranties on select recycled parts; Environmentally safe fluid recovery and recycling (freon, coolant, oil, fuel, brake fluid)
